usage: agentbreeder registry fork [-h] [--as NAME] [--version X.Y.Z]
                                  [--project PROJECT] [--dry-run |
                                  --expect-digest SHA256] [--json]
                                  ref

positional arguments:
  ref                   kind/name@X.Y.Z

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --as NAME             Fork under this name
  --version X.Y.Z       Fork as this version
  --project PROJECT
  --dry-run             Check and hash a staged copy; write nothing
  --expect-digest SHA256
                        Refuse unless the staged copy has this digest (from
                        --dry-run)
  --json
